title: Gehry 1.0 Filter
summary:
If you check out Forma — the Frank Gehry-designed condo tower rising at King and Duncan streets in Downtown Toronto — from the windows of the Scotiabank Theatre, a couple blocks to the northwest, it's like the windows are there as a filter to bring back the original swoops in the exterior that were in Gehry's early designs for the complex. The distortions seem to have some history baked in.
